phrase.en: Go straight ahead and turn left at the corner.
phrase.ru: Идите прямо и на углу поверните налево.
phrase.es: Siga recto y gire a la izquierda en la esquina.

text.ru: Дорогу объясняют повелительным: глагол без подлежащего — Go, Turn, Take. «На углу» — at the corner, «за углом» — around the corner; «прямо» — straight ahead.
text.en: Directions use the imperative — the verb with no subject: Go, Turn, Take. At the corner vs around the corner; straight ahead means “straight on”.
text.es: Las indicaciones van en imperativo: Go, Turn, Take. at the corner — en la esquina; around the corner — a la vuelta; straight ahead — todo recto.

examples.en: The station is just around the corner.

exercises.en: The station is around the corner.
